summary: Official SPC page confirms a current Fall 2026 Founder Fellowship cycle, with applications opening in summer 2026 and the cohort kicking off in late September. Exact application deadline and exact program dates are not published.

proposed_event.name: South Park Commons Founder Fellowship Fall 2026
proposed_event.description: Pre-idea founder fellowship with capital, credits, mentorship, and SPC community access.

location.venue: SPC offices in San Francisco or New York City

dates.date_range_text: Applications open summer 2026; Fall 2026 cohort kicks off in late September. SPC runs Founder Fellowship cohorts every Spring and Fall.

sources.title: Founder Fellowship — South Park Commons
sources.supports: Official page states applications for the Fall 2026 cohort open in summer 2026, the cohort kicks off in late September, cohorts run every Spring and Fall, terms are $400k upfront for 7% plus $600k in the next external round, credits/perks are offered, and bootcamp work is in-person in San Francisco or New York City.

sources.title: FAQ - South Park Commons
sources.supports: Official FAQ states Founder Fellowship applications open twice per year and have deadlines, while general SPC member applications are rolling.

sources.title: SPC Founder Fellowship Spring 2026
sources.supports: Official past cohort announcement supports program structure and taxonomy context: Founder Fellowship is organized by South Park Commons, offers $400k for 7% plus $600k in the next external round, offers credits/perks, and uses bootcamp plus residency phases.

notes: Exact Fall 2026 application open date, deadline, bootcamp end date, and demo faire date were not public on the official pages checked.
Spring 2026 blog details are past as of 2026-06-09 and are used only to corroborate organizer and program structure, not as current dates.
